fact: Version 2 of the Government ICT Specifications Standards, issued by the Office of the President and Cabinet's e-Government Technology Unit in May 2025 and effective immediately, is binding on all ministries, departments and agencies under Cabinet Circular No. 22 of 2022 and requires software to be interoperable by design and based on open standards.
title: GOVERNMENT ICT SPECIFICATIONS STANDARDS (Version 2)
publisher: Office of the President and Cabinet, E-Government Technology Unit
